1.) New Feature: Intro Screen when starting app for the first time (allows you to setup Encryption and Authentication) 

 2.) New Feature: Broadcast receivers to trigger backups from Tasker


 3.) New Feature: Added support for using Android Backup 

 4.) New Feature: Added option to append date and time to backups 

 5.) New Feature: Check if entries are valid when manually linking an account to CometOTP 

 6.) New Feature: Added different options for tag selection 

 7.) New Feature: Show a warning when trying to change Database Encryption type in Settings page 

 8.) Bug Fix: Fixed crash when trying to save an empty LABEL name 

 9.) Bug Fix: Fixed account thumbnails visibility after switching between dark Themes 

 10.) Don't require credentials again after device screen rotation!
